item.title: They Defended Their Son. He Admitted Killing His Brother.
item.description: Zachary Witman was 15 when his brother Greg, 13, was killed in their Pennsylvania home in 1998. His parents defended his innocence for years. In 2018, he admitted the killing and pleaded guilty to third-degree murder. He was paroled in 2019.

item.title: Charlie Sheen Was Her Client. Then He Testified Against Her.
item.description: Heidi Fleiss became known as the “Hollywood Madam” for running a prostitution ring serving wealthy clients. Charlie Sheen testified against her under an immunity deal. In 1997, she received a 37-month federal sentence for tax evasion and money laundering.

item.title: She Played A Killer While On Bail For Shooting Her Uncle
item.description: Tucker Reed starred in the thriller “From the Dark” while awaiting trial for fatally shooting her uncle, Shane Moore, in Oregon in 2016. The filmmakers learned of her case after filming wrapped. In 2020, she pleaded guilty to second-degree manslaughter and received 75 months in prison.

item.title: Diddy Celebrated His Acquittals. Then The Judge Denied Bail
item.description: Sean “Diddy” Combs celebrated after jurors acquitted him of racketeering conspiracy and sex trafficking in July 2025. But two convictions for transportation to engage in prostitution kept him in custody, and he was sentenced to 50 months that October.

item.title: The Livestream Claims That Followed Yu Menglong’s Death
item.description: After Chinese actor Yu Menglong, 37, died in a fall in Beijing in September 2025, online claims portrayed his livestreams as hidden pleas for help. Those interpretations remain unverified. Police said he fell accidentally after drinking and ruled out criminal involvement.

item.title: Israel Keyes Buried Murder Kits Across The Country
item.description: Israel Keyes hid weapons and supplies across the U.S. for future crimes, according to the FBI. Transactions on a stolen debit card linked to Samantha Koenig’s abduction led to his 2012 arrest. He confessed to multiple killings but died by suicide in custody before trial.

item.title: Ruby Franke’s Counselor Moved In. Her Husband Moved Out.
item.description: YouTuber Ruby Franke’s husband Kevin said she shared therapist Jodi Hildebrandt’s bed to ward off “demons” before telling him to leave their home. Both women later pleaded guilty to aggravated child abuse and received prison sentences of four to 30 years in 2024.

item.title: They Cut Their Tent Open And Fled Into The Snow
item.description: Nine hikers led by Igor Dyatlov died in the Ural Mountains in 1959 after fleeing a tent cut open from inside. A 2020 Russian inquiry blamed an avalanche, and later scientific research supported that explanation, though the precise sequence remains uncertain.
